snippet.title: Basement To The Sky - Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello!
I’m orange3000k, a solo indie game developer.

This is the first trailer for my debut game, Basement to the Sky.
The Steam page is now live, so feel free to check it out.
If you like what you see, please consider adding it to your wishlist on Steam — it really helps a lot!
